sections.description:
'BALUCHISTAN MEDICAL GRADUATES (COMPULSORY
BALUCHISTAN MEDICAL GRADUATES (COMPULSORY
SERVICE) RULES, 1975
[Gazette of Baluchistan,
Extraordinary, 22nd August 1975]
No. SOII (H) 1‑1/74‑10548.‑In
exercise of the power conferred by ‑section 6 of the Medical Graduates
(Compulsory Service) Act, 1974 (Act XX of 1974), the Government of Baluchistan
is pleased to make the following
Rules, namely :‑
1. Short title, commencement and application.‑(i)
These rules may be called the Baluchistan Medical Graduates (Compulsory
Service) Rules, 1975.
(ii) They shall come into force
at once and shall apply to all Medical Graduates wherever they may be.
2. Definition.‑In these rules, unless the context otherwise
requires :‑
(i) "Act" means the
Baluchistan Medical Graduates (Compulsory Service) Act, 1974.
(1l) "Government" means the Government of
Baluchistan.
(iii) "Medical Graduates" means as defined
in the .Act.
(iV) "Notice" means
notice issued in pursuance of section 3 of ‑the Act.
3. Notice.‑A
notice requisitioning the service of a Medical Graduate shall be in the
form as in the schedule appended to these rules and shall be issued by
Government.
4. Time limit.‑The person
whose services are requisitioned under this Act shall report for duty to the
Secretary Health Department within fifteen
days of the service of the notice on him, .r failing which he shall be
liable to ,prosecution under sections 4 and 5 of the Act.

the Province of Baluchistan for at least 5 years;
And whereas your services are required by the
Government of Baluchis?tan under section 3 of the Medical Graduates (Compulsory
Service) Act, 1974, you are hereby, called upon to report for duty to the
Secretary to Government of Baluchistan, Health Department, within fifteen days
of the receipt of this notice, failing which action will be taken against you
under, sections 4 and 5 of the said Act.
